```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, fixest, quantreg)


DataSCLB = haven::read_dta(here::here("blog", "data", "Quantile Vs Distribution Regression", "DataSCLB.dta"))

# Function to run threshold analysis
run_threshold_analysis <- function(data, outcome_var, treat_var = "treat") {
  
  # Initialize results data frame
  results <- data.frame(
    threshold = integer(),
    coefficient = numeric(),
    std_error = numeric()
  )
  
  # Loop through thresholds 0 to 100
  for (x in seq(-1, 9, by = 0.5)) {
    # Create binary outcome variable for current threshold
    outcome_binary <- as.numeric(data[[outcome_var]] > x & !is.na(data[[outcome_var]]))
    
    # Skip if no variation in outcome
    if (length(unique(outcome_binary[!is.na(outcome_binary)])) <= 1) {
      next
    }
    
    # Create temporary dataset with binary outcome
    temp_data <- data
    temp_data$outcome_temp <- outcome_binary
    
    # Run fixed effects regression with interactions
    # This is equivalent to areg with cluster() and absorb()
    tryCatch({
      model <- feols(
        as.formula(paste0("outcome_temp ~ ", treat_var)),
        data = temp_data
      )
      
      # Extract coefficient and standard error for treatment
      coef_treat <- coef(model)[treat_var]
      se_treat <- se(model)[treat_var]
      
      # Add to results
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
        threshold = x,
        coefficient = coef_treat,
        std_error = se_treat
      ))
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      # Skip if regression fails
      message(paste("Threshold", x, "failed:", e$message))
    })
  }
  
  return(results)
}


run_threshold_analysis(DataSCLB, outcome_var = "EL_EGRA_PCA_Index", treat_var = "MT_Program") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = threshold, y = coefficient)) +
  geom_point(color = "blue") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = coefficient - 1.96 * std_error,
                    ymax = coefficient + 1.96 * std_error),
                width = 0.1, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "longdash") + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,0.3)) +
  cowplot::theme_cowplot() + 
  labs(x = "Higher Reading Score Than This", y = "", subtitle = "Increase Reading Index More Than This Much (Percentage Points)", title = "The gap between treatment and control decreases at higher thresholds")
```

```{r}
# Function to run quantile regression analysis (fixed version)
run_quantile_analysis <- function(data, outcome_var, treat_var = "treat") {
  
  # Initialize results data frame
  results <- data.frame(
    quantile = numeric(),
    coefficient = numeric(),
    std_error = numeric()
  )
  
  # Loop through quantiles from 0.05 to 0.95
  for (q in seq(0.05, 0.95, by = 0.05)) {
    
    tryCatch({
      # Run quantile regression
      model <- rq(
        as.formula(paste0(outcome_var, " ~ ", treat_var)),
        data = data,
        tau = q
      )
      
      # Get summary with standard errors
      model_summary <- summary(model, se = "nid")
      
      # Extract coefficients more safely
      coef_matrix <- model_summary$coefficients
      coef_names <- rownames(coef_matrix)
      
      # Find the treatment variable (handle different naming)
      treat_idx <- which(coef_names == treat_var)
      
      if (length(treat_idx) == 1) {
        # Extract coefficient and standard error for treatment
        coef_treat <- coef_matrix[treat_idx, 1]  # First column is coefficients
        se_treat <- coef_matrix[treat_idx, 2]    # Second column is std errors
        
        # Add to results
        results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
          quantile = q,
          coefficient = coef_treat,
          std_error = se_treat
        ))
      } else {
        message(paste("Quantile", q, ": Treatment variable", treat_var, "not found"))
        message("Available coefficients:", paste(coef_names, collapse = ", "))
      }
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      # Skip if regression fails
      message(paste("Quantile", q, "failed:", e$message))
    })
  }
  
  return(results)
}

run_quantile_analysis(DataSCLB, outcome_var = "EL_EGRA_PCA_Index", treat_var = "MT_Program") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = quantile, y = coefficient)) +
  geom_point(color = "blue") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = coefficient - 1.96 * std_error,
                    ymax = coefficient + 1.96 * std_error),
                width = 0.01, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "longdash") + 
  cowplot::theme_cowplot() + 
  labs(x = "Quantile", y = "", subtitle = "Effect Size (SDs)", title = "Reading scores increase at higher quantiles")
```
